    def open_new_message_and_validate_single_user(self):
        """Open the new message composer via 'New Message' or '+' button (whichever is present),
        then open the user dropdown and validate exactly one user option is available."""
        new_message_btn = self.page.locator(self.EMPTY_STATE_NEW_MESSAGE_BTN)
        plus_btn = self.page.locator(self.NEW_MESSAGE_BUTTON)
    
        # Click whichever button appears using Playwright's or_ locator.
        # or_ auto-waits for one of the two to become actionable before clicking,
        # which eliminates the flaky "Neither button is present" race caused by
        # instantaneous is_visible() checks running before React finishes rendering.
        new_message_btn.or_(plus_btn).first.click()
    
        # Open the user select dropdown
        self.page.locator(self.USER_SELECT_DROPDOWN).click()
        self.page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
        # Validate exactly one user option is visible.
        # Use an index-independent locator because react-select ids vary depending
        # on how many select components were mounted earlier in the suite.
        options = self.page.locator(self.USER_SELECT_OPTION_ANY)
